jobs.description:
Part of your life. Part of tomorrow.

We make life easier, safer and greener, with technology that achieves more, consumes less and is accessible to everyone. Microelectronics from Infineon is the key to a better future. Key responsibilities in your new role

Collaborate with internal stakeholders and the RPT team to align on

development progress, requirements, and timelines

Simulate and analyze complex circuit designs for advanced hardware

development

Create PCB schematics, layouts, component selections, and stack-up

definitions to develop prototypes

Perform thorough design reviews and comprehensive hardware verifications

Optimize existing test systems actively and define design guidelines for stress

hardware development

Support troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of hardware failures during

qualification testing

Develop software tools, test scripts, and automation applications for system

control, monitoring, and data collection

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

A Master's or PhD degree in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a comparable

engineering field

Deep knowledge of high-frequency, high-power DC/DC converter topologies

(e.g., Buck, Boost, Flyback, LLC) for SMPS applications

A solid understanding of the theory, selection, and practical application of

magnetics and capacitors

Proven experience in microcontroller programming (such as XMC, C8051)

utilizing C, C++, and LUA

Extensive expertise in high-frequency PCB design, EMC guidelines, circuit

design, and simulation tools like Altium, Cadence, LTSpice, or MATLAB

A natural problem solver characterized by strong analytical thinking and

structured troubleshooting skills

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a

collaborative and proactive approach

Fluency in English is required; German language proficiency is considered a

strong asset
